author: Top Gear
description:
In this video Top Gear takes a look at the new 820bhp Ferrari 12Cilindri Manuale. It’s a new Ferrari with an 820bhp V12 and, crucially, a manual gearbox. We haven’t seen a three-pedal Ferrari in over a decade, so the Manuale is a limited-build Special Series car – but the manual gearbox is actually a bit of fake, and borrows a few ideas from Swedish hypercar royalty Koenigsegg…
